set.body: The frozen gaps-binocular ASC generator emits integer pupil tokens, which cause pinned pymovements 0.28.0 from_asc to fail with TypeError. Its space-separated LEFT RIGHT declaration also leaves parsed tracked-eye metadata blank. Make a bounded protocol amendment with parseable pupil tokens and explicit pupil, recording, geometry and eye metadata; preserve sample values, gaps, rate, row counts and all numeric budgets. Regenerate source-bound input identities and verify all three scales, plus a small exact eye/message/sample conformance probe in both parsers. Document the changed protocol identity and invalidate old exploratory timing comparability. Do not score performance or silently replace a qualified baseline.
set.title: PM3.4a Correct frozen binocular ASC fixture for both pinned parsers
